sources: Winter & Perry Clinical Gait Benchmark Standards

metadata.name: AddBiomechanics OpenSim Dataset (Stanford / SimTK)
metadata.description: Large-scale dataset of physically validated human motion and OpenSim inverse kinematics.

normal_gait.name: Healthy Adult Baseline Gait
normal_gait.description: Symmetrical, fluid gait cycle with physiological ROM across all joint planes.

crouch_gait.name: Crouch Gait Pattern
crouch_gait.description: Excessive knee and hip flexion throughout stance phase, hyper-dorsiflexed ankle, elevated muscle effort.

stiff_knee_gait.name: Stiff Knee Swing Gait
stiff_knee_gait.description: Marked reduction in peak swing knee flexion (<35°), elevating toe stubbing and tripping risk.

equinus_gait.name: Equinus / Toe Walking Gait
equinus_gait.description: Persistent ankle plantarflexion at initial contact and stance phase, absent heel strike.

trendelenburg_gait.name: Trendelenburg / Pelvic Drop Gait
trendelenburg_gait.description: Uncompensated contralateral pelvic drop and excessive hip adduction during stance phase.

sam3d_monocular.name: SAM 3D Monocular Tracked Trial
sam3d_monocular.description: Single-leg lunge motion extracted directly from monocular video using SAM 3D.
